title: [T-0032] Add executor file-safety guardrail to pipeline
summary: Add executor file-safety guardrail to pipeline
followup_notes: T-0032 added a file safety guardrail to the executor pipeline in `execute-task-api.mjs`. Before the LLM call, all source files in the repo root are snapshotted (line count + content stored in memory). After file writing, each written file is validated against its snapshot: files that shrink by > 30%…
